query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS email_threads (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  prospectId INT,
  threadId VARCHAR(512),
  direction VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  fromAddress VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL,
  toAddress VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL,
  subject TEXT,
  body TEXT,
  htmlBody TEXT,
  resendMessageId VARCHAR(255),
  inReplyTo TEXT,
  `references` TEXT,
  receivedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales_agent_conversations (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  prospectId INT NOT NULL,
  state VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'discovery',
  strategy TEXT,
  outreachAngle TEXT,
  lastActivityAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  nextFollowUpAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  followUpCount INT DEFAULT 0,
  notes TEXT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales_agent_runs (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  runType VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',
  prospectsFound INT DEFAULT 0,
  prospectsCreated INT DEFAULT 0,
  emailsSent INT DEFAULT 0,
  showsFound INT DEFAULT 0,
  errorMessage TEXT,
  details JSON,
  startedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  completedAt TIMESTAMP NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vendors (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  website VARCHAR(512),
  contact_name VARCHAR(255),
  contact_email VARCHAR(320),
  contact_phone VARCHAR(64),
  address TEXT,
  city VARCHAR(100),
  state VARCHAR(50),
  country VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'US',
  notes TEXT,
  rating INT,
  is_active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1,
  scraped_from VARCHAR(512),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS logistics_workflows (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  orderId INT NOT NULL,
  prospectId INT,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  robotCompany VARCHAR(255),
  robotName VARCHAR(255),
  showName VARCHAR(255),
  showStartDate TIMESTAMP NULL,
  notes TEXT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS logistics_checkpoints (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  workflowId INT NOT NULL,
  type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  dueAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  completedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  responsibleParty VARCHAR(64),
  vendorId INT,
  trackingNumber VARCHAR(255),
  carrierName VARCHAR(100),
  notes TEXT,
  problemDescription TEXT,
  problemSeverity VARCHAR(32),
  escalatedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  resolvedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  metadata JSON,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scheduling_slots (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  hostName VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  hostEmail VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL,
  slotStart TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  slotEnd TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  isBooked TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0,
  bookedByProspectId INT,
  bookedByName VARCHAR(255),
  bookedByEmail VARCHAR(320),
  meetingNotes TEXT,
  calendarEventId VARCHAR(512),
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
